verdict.line: You lose if you walk Broken Wings into his Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow before your W (Ki Burst) stun is online at level 3; you win by baiting his Searing Charge (E) away from terrain and collapsing once Blade of the Exile (R) comes up at 6.

brief.thesis: Ornn's Q (Volcanic Rupture) hits at 800 range while every Riven tool tops out at 275, so he pokes you for free until you have a reason to close the gap. Riven's skill order (QEWQQR...) means Ki Burst's stun doesn't exist until level 3, leaving the first two levels as pure poke exchange with no punish for Riven. Once W is online and Conqueror is stacking, the 51.6% win rate over 535 games reflects a lane that's genuinely even and decided by whether you bait his cooldowns or he baits yours.

theirWindow.when: right after his Q (Volcanic Rupture) lands
theirWindow.what: He follows the slow with Searing Charge (E); if he collides with terrain while charging it creates a knockup shockwave on top of you. Back off walls the instant Q hits you.

yourWindow.when: when his E (Searing Charge) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no terrain-knockup threat up, step into Broken Wings (Q) range and trade freely — he has no hard CC left to punish the engage until E resets.

start.why: 94.7% pick rate at 51.5% win over 590 games — the sustain and AD let you contest his Q poke without falling behind on trades.

boots.why: 52.7% win over 389 games; the extra ability haste shortens Broken Wings (13s) and Ki Burst (11-7s) so you can answer his Q-E combo more often.

core.why: Highest-performing opener at 64.3% win over 42 games — the shield absorbs part of his Q (Volcanic Rupture) poke during the all-in.

runes.keystoneWhy: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to keep Conqueror stacks up — the adaptive damage and healing reward you for staying in extended trades against Ornn's tankier scaling.

summoners.why: 93.3% pick rate at 50% win — this is an even, skill-decided lane, and Ignite is what converts a landed Ki Burst (W) stun into an actual solo kill instead of just a trade.

playing.title: Delay all-ins to level 3
playing.detail: Don't commit Broken Wings (Q) before Ki Burst (W) is online — without the stun at level 3, you have no answer to his Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow kiting you.

playing.title: Bait Searing Charge off walls
playing.detail: Ornn's E (Searing Charge) only knocks up if he collides with terrain while charging. Stay off nearby walls whenever his E is up to strip the combo entirely.

playing.title: Punish whiffed Q casts
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture (Q) is 9-7s on cooldown with a visible delay before the magma pillar forms — step in and trade with Broken Wings (Q) the moment he misses it.

playing.title: Use Valor to eat Bellows Breath
playing.detail: Ornn's W (Bellows Breath) is a forward advance that only applies Brittle on the final gout of flame; time Valor's (E) damage block into his approach to shrug the trade.

playing.title: All-in once E and R are down
playing.detail: Searing Charge (14-12s) and Call of the Forge God (140-100s) are his only hard engage and peel. With both on cooldown, use Blade of the Exile (R) to force a fight he can't escape.

playing.title: Track his Living Forge gold
playing.detail: His passive lets him forge items anywhere without recalling, so an early kill or plate lead can quietly evaporate — push your advantage before his first masterwork item completes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern calls are my own read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo while engaging him. Keep your Conqueror’s stacks up and engage with your abilities.
